title: Bunk Johnson and E. Vans band at Thibodaux
summary: Bunk came to get Morris on his last visit but took Jim Robinson; Morris recalls running into Bunk's band out in the country.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Did you ever know Bunk Johnson?

Sure, I used to play with Bunk Oh, yeah When Bunk first come here to leave here that last time, he come here to get me Oh, yeah But I was busy working, that's why he did to take Jim Crow And then Jim Crow and Howard and them, they was working together all the time So he couldn't get me the first week he was here, so that's why I just let him went on with him But Bunk come right there to get me Yeah, Bunk was playing with the Black Devil up in Tippeto up there I was playing with Punch, you ask Punch about it, we used to run them everywhere we'd catch them Whose band was that? That was E. Vans band Oh, yeah Yeah, E. Vans was his name out in the country Good band But we knew when we'd meet them out there out there will
Buck like I don't know what. Punch was playing with us then.
